verses.text: Yuj wal jun niwan tiempo manhxalaj nhab' syak'a', yuj chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik, ix yalan icha tik:
Ha heb' aj Judá tz'ok' wal heb' yuj kusk'olal, manhxa yip schonhab' heb', toxonhej teltumb'a heb' t'a sat lu'um yuj kusk'olal. Sk'e wal yaw heb' aj Jerusalén yuj sya'elal.
Ha heb' b'eyum, schekb'at heb' schekab' heb' ik'oj ha'. Sb'at heb' say ha' t'a yoltak jul, palta manhxalaj ha', malaj yol sch'ub' heb' smeltzaj heb'. Toxonhej smak sat heb' yuj k'ixwelal.
Sk'e tamaljok lum lum sjat yuj stak'inhal. Yuj chi' a heb' munlajwum, stak wal sk'ol heb', smak sat heb' yuj k'ixwelal.
Icha chi' nok' k'ultakil chej, syaktejkan yune' nok' toto tz'alji, yujto manhxa anh ank'ultak sk'ux nok'.

Yet' nok' kaltakte'al b'uru, ha t'a tzalkixtak b'aj malaj ste'al skot tek'tek' nok'. Suk'lan ik' nok' icha nok' okes. Sk'unb'i wal yol sat nok' yilani, yujto manhxa anh ank'ultak wach' sk'uxan nok', xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, wach'chom te niwan ko mul t'a a sat, palta kolwajanh t'ayonh yik wach' max ach alchaj chukal. Tzijtum el sko pitej ko b'a t'ayach, tz'ochpax ko mul.

Ha achnhej ayach och yipok ko k'o'ol, a achnhej pax ko Kolumal aji ayik ayonh och t'a sya'elal. ¿Tas yuj icha ch'ok chonhab'il tzutej a b'a t'a ko chonhab' tik, icha junok paxyalwum junnhej ak'wal tzek' t'ayonh?
¿Tas yuj lajan ach icha junok soldado satk'olal yaji syamji, maxtzak yal skolwaji? Palta Mamin, tik pax ayachek' t'a ko kal. Masanil chonhab' ojtannak to a chonhab' onh. Manh onh aktejkani, xin chi.

Haton juntzanh tik ix yal Jehová yuj heb' chonhab' israel: Ha heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' tik, te ay stzalajk'olal heb' sb'eyek'i. Sb'at heb' t'a jun, sb'at heb' t'a junxo. Yuj chi' manh jab'ok tzin tzalaj yet' heb'. Ha tiknaik ol in nakot schukal heb', ol in ch'olb'itan tastak sk'ulej heb', xchi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Manh ach tewok t'ayin yuj swach'ilok juntzanh anima t'a jun chonhab' tik.

Wach'chom tz'och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal, palta manh ol in tak'woklaj t'a heb'. Wach'chom tzijtum silab' snhus heb' yet' jantak sat awb'en syik'kot heb' ofrendail, palta manh ol in tzalaj yet' heb'. Ol in satel heb' yuj owal, yuj wejel yet' pax yuj ilya, xchi t'ayin.

Ix in tak'wi t'a Jehová chi' icha tik: Palta Mamin Jehová in Diosal, a heb' syaloch sb'a a chekab'ok, syal heb' t'a heb' anima tik to malaj owal ol ochok. Malaj wejel ol jawok. Syal heb' to ol ak'nhej junk'olal b'aj kajan onh tik, xin chi.

Ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tato icha chi' tz'aj yalanel heb' chekab' chi' t'a in b'i, wan yesan heb' syal chi', yujto manhok in tzin chek yal heb'. Malaj junok cheknab'il ix wak' t'a heb', maj in lolonpax t'a heb'. Ha juntzanh syal heb' chi' to a in ix wak' yil heb' yalani, palta manh yeloklaj, malaj yelk'ochi. Munil t'a yol yik heb' snacha'anh juntzanh syal chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swal t'a juntzanh chekab' stek'b'ej sb'a yalanel t'a in b'i to malaj owal, malaj wejel ol jawok t'a yib'anh chonhab' tik, manhok in tzin chek yal heb', yuj chi' ol cham heb' yuj owal yet' yuj wejel chi'.

Yet' pax heb' anima b'aj syal heb' chi', ol cham heb' yuj owal yet' wejel. Ol cham heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yet' yalyuninal. Toxonhej ol kan teljab' sniwanil heb' t'a yoltak scalleal chonhab' Jerusalén. Malaj mach ol mukan heb'. Icha chi' ol aj stupanel smul heb' ix yak'ochi.
Yuj chi' al juntzanh tik t'a heb' anima: k'uhal dak'walxo yel yal in sat wok' yuj ya'elal ayxo smay ix jawi t'a yib'anh heb' wetchonhab', yuj ya'elal tz'ak'an echnaj heb'.

Ayik tzin ek' t'a kal munlajel swilani, ay sniwanil anima teltumb'a yajkan yuj owal. Haxo yik tzin ochxita t'a yol chonhab' tik, swilani to wan scham anima yuj wejel. Haxo heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios yet' heb' sacerdote, toxo ix ik'chajb'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il manh yojtakok, xa chi, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Yuj chi' ix walan icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ¿tom junelnhej ix ik'el heb' aj Judá tik t'a a k'o'ol? ¿Tom toxo ix a patikejel chonhab' Sion? ¿Tas yuj ix onh ak' echnajok to maxtzak yal kanhtaji? Sko nib'ej junk'olal kaji, palta malaj jab'ok tas wach' sjawi t'ayonh. Sko na' to wach'nhej ol onh b'ey t'a kichanh, palta anhej tas ay smay ix ja t'a kib'anh.
Mamin Jehová, skojtakejel ko chukal yet' pax spitalil heb' ko mam kicham. Ix och wal ko mul t'ayach.
Yuj wal yik'jicha'anh a b'i, manhxo onh a patikejeli. Manh a patikejel jun chonhab' tik b'aj ay a despacho to niwan yelk'ochi. Nakot a trato ix ak' ket'ok. ¿Tokwal manh ol ak'elk'ochi?

Malaj junok komon Dios, sdiosal ch'ok chonhab'il ol yal yak'ankot nhab'. Ha satcha'anh max yal-laj yak'ankot yaxnhab' t'a yol yiko'. Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach, yuj chi' tzach kak'och yipok ko k'o'ol, yujto a achnhej tzak'kot juntzanh tik, xin chi t'a Jehová.
